skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the basics of cadastral surveying
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the basic concepts, principles, and methods of cadastral surveying.
Students will be able to interpret and use topographic coordinates and heights in cadastral surveying.
Students will learn how to use various surveying instruments and tools for cadastral surveying.
Students will develop the ability to analyze and interpret data collected during cadastral surveys.
Students will be able to create accurate cadastral maps based on survey data.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Managing and using cadastral maps and records
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will learn how to manage and utilize cadastral maps and records effectively.
Students will develop the ability to independently study and improve their knowledge in cadastral surveying.
Students will work collaboratively in teams to complete group projects and assignments.
Students will apply critical thinking skills to solve problems related to cadastral surveying.
